source_review: DataStorage.doRollback reads previous/VERSION and rejects a previous layout version older than running software or a previous cTime newer than NamespaceInfo. TestDFSRollback intentionally writes Long.MAX_VALUE as previous cTime and expects this exact exception. A post-fault guard throw with the same normalized state is an expected version rejection; a novel state must be replayed and reviewed before any bug claim.
